lenses.note: Every OSS7 exit condition maps to an ordered step and retained artifact.
The RC-first boundary prevents an untagged tree from masquerading as immutable evidence.
Frozen preview handoffs detect backward-incompatible schema drift; tagged host runs test portability.
Two ordered PRs preserve reviewability and allow rollback to the existing preview tag.
The plan rejects prior unpinned work as qualifying evidence and requires exact revisions for every mission.

claims.statement: The plan can prove stable-v1 qualification without circular artifact evidence.

residual_risks: Behavioral portability remains unproven until the tagged external missions complete.
note: The two-PR candidate-first release plan is coherent and ready for implementation.
